record.dic_text:
4679 sophizo {sof-id'-zo}

源自 4680; TDNT - 7:527,1056; 動詞

欽定本- make wise 1, cunningly devised 1; 2

1) 使有智慧, 教導 (#提後3:15|)
2) (耍弄聰明) 巧妙策動 (#彼後1:16|)
record.edic_text:
4679 sophizo {sof-id'-zo}

from 4680; TDNT - 7:527,1056; v

AV - make wise 1, cunningly devised 1; 2

1) to make wise, teach
2) to become wise, to have understanding
   2a) to invent, play the sophist
   2b) to devise cleverly or cunningly

same.cexp: 智慧，洞見，聰明，學問；（神的）智慧
智慧的，有經驗的；內行的（建築師）
哲學（含有貶意），人的智慧（#西 2:8|）
哲學家，（哲學或思想的）教師（#徒 17:18|）
